title: Frontend image-owned mime.types missing; site restore cannot repair it
root_causes: The frontend image-owned /etc/nginx/mime.types was removed; restarting retains the deletion. Confirm the exact missing path from frontend startup logs.

checks.purpose: Require [emerg] open() /etc/nginx/mime.types failed; a read-only mounted default.conf notice is unrelated.
Confirm frontend exited; an exited container cannot run docker_exec.
This reads the mounted SITE only; restore_config cannot recreate image-owned mime.types.

remediation.action: After confirming that missing image file, docker_start {"name":"edge-victim"} once; collect fresh frontend logs and check_health {}.
If same missing image file and health failure persist after start/restart, recreate_stack {"name":"edge-victim","replace":true} under reviewer; check_health {}.

OPERATOR ONLY: docker cp <same-image-known-good-mime.types> edge-victim:/etc/nginx/mime.types; docker start edge-victim. Verify nginx -t when running and both health URLs; preserve any existing file first.

rollback: Keep the image digest and any previous single-file backup. Replacement has no writable-layer undo; if the baseline cannot be reconstructed, stop and restore the approved deployment/backup with an operator. Do not restore the injected missing state.
verify: check_health {}: / and /api/ both 200, then repeat after a short observation interval; a tool success alone is not recovery.
docker_ps {}: target stays Up; inspect fresh logs for the original error.
safety: Recorded failure labels are not live proof. Confirm the target and mechanism before any write; search_runbooks first.

title: Upstream running but Nginx workers stopped by SIGSTOP
root_causes: Worker processes can be stopped while PID 1 and the container remain running. Timeout alone does not establish SIGSTOP.

checks.purpose: Confirm Up rather than Paused or Exited; inspect backend logs and health.
Read actual child PID(s); do not invent a PID or assume ps is installed.
Confirm nginx worker and State T/t; inspect another child if needed. Missing files or exec errors are not proof.

remediation.action: With stopped workers confirmed, docker_restart {"name":"edge-victim-app"} once to replace the process tree; check_health {}.
If still failing, re-read worker state, pids limits, logs and network evidence. Do not repeatedly restart or rewrite healthy frontend config; escalate if the stop recurs.

OPERATOR ONLY alternative: after verifying each stopped worker PID, docker exec edge-victim-app kill -CONT <verified-worker-pid>. docker kill --signal=CONT targets PID 1 and does not resume independently stopped workers.

rollback: Do not undo recovery by sending SIGSTOP again. Preserve evidence if an external actor keeps stopping workers; restore the approved process baseline or escalate.

title: Backend own Nginx config forces 301/429; distinguish legitimate traffic policy
root_causes: The demo injection writes an unconditional return 301 or return 429 into the backend writable config. Real rate limiting or intentional redirects require a different response.

checks.purpose: Read direct status and Location without following redirects; compare with front /api/.
Require the backend unconditional return or confirmed loop; read_config is frontend-only.
Correlate direct responses; a 429 alone is not proof of a broken config or overload.

remediation.action: For confirmed injected backend response rule, docker_restart {"name":"edge-victim-app"} once; check_health {}.
If same own-layer rule and non-200 /api/ persist after restart, recreate_stack {"name":"edge-victim-app","replace":true} under reviewer; check_health {}.

OPERATOR ONLY alternative: save the affected backend file, docker cp <approved-backend-default.conf> edge-victim-app:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf, then nginx -t and reload/restart the confirmed target. Never disable a legitimate rate limit globally.

rollback: Restore only an approved previously healthy backend file using docker cp and validate it before restart. Never restore the injected return/loop. Replacement has no automatic writable-layer rollback.

title: Frontend running without a listener because mounted site config is empty
root_causes: An empty mounted frontend site can pass nginx -t while defining no server/listen block. Recreating the container keeps the empty host mount.

checks.purpose: Distinguish Up with no service from stopped/paused containers.
Require empty/missing expected server block in the FRONTEND mounted site.
Confirm effective configuration lacks the expected listener; syntax success is not HTTP readiness.

remediation.action: For confirmed empty frontend site, restore_config {"source":"known-good"}; docker_restart {"name":"edge-victim"}; check_health {}.
If no known-good snapshot exists, use write_config with the full approved frontend configuration from this deployment, then docker_restart edge-victim and check_health. Never invent proxy routes.

rollback: If a newly written configuration regresses, restore_config {"source":"previous"} only when that previous snapshot was verified healthy, then restart frontend and verify both URLs. Preserve the empty file as evidence rather than treating it as a rollback target.
